verdict.rationale: Mastra is itself a first-party TypeScript SDK/framework (@mastra/core, @mastra/mcp-docs-server, etc.) with extensive official documentation covering agents, tools, memory, workflows, and model routing to 40+ providers, and community comments confirm real-world usage building on it as an SDK. Missing for 10: no evidence of official SDKs in other languages (e.g., Python) or a formal API reference/OpenAPI spec (probe found no openapi.json), and independent corroboration is limited to community sentiment rather than technical SDK conformance testing.
